name: yt-dlp-z
description: Web dashboard for yt-dlp with presets, channel watching and live-stream recording.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: The database, the secret key, job logs and uploaded cookies.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Your downloads, in /mnt/cache/downloads/yt-dlp-z, where the Files app and media servers can see them.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: yt-dlp-z web app, published on host as 6705

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
